about: The shared loader with an atlas mod: sprite_replace naming an atlas entry is baked first, so the size error names the entry (4 x 8), not the last strip loaded; world takes the baked entry. An atlas entry the size of a game sprite with origin 0,0 keeps that origin (the entry's xo/yo are not used).

steps.name: gnx_scn_sprite_geom
steps.why: world takes the baked atlas entry, with the origin the JSON gave (2,7, not the atlas's 1,6)

steps.name: gnx_scn_sprite_geom
steps.why: an explicit origin 0,0 wins over the atlas entry's (the resolver only lets a non-zero one win)
